effects: Allows enabling or disabling automatic collection of specific user data based on user consent.

conditions: User has provided consent to enable GeoIP, device brand, and device model data collection.
effects: GeoIP, device brand, and device model information will be captured automatically by the SDK.

conditions: User has revoked consent for collection.
effects: GeoIP, device brand, and device model information will not be captured.

conditions: Called after Batch.onStart(Activity) to ensure the SDK has started.
effects: Prevents Batch from performing any operations, disabling all campaigns and network capabilities.
Disables the SDK, wipes local data, and requests remote removal of associated data.

conditions: Must be called after the user has opted out to re-enable SDK functionalities.
effects: Re-enables the SDK functionalities after an opt-out.
